name: CloberDEX Liquidity Vault
rootCause: On December 10, 2024, the CloberDEX Liquidity Vault on Base was exploited for 133.7 ETH (~$501,000) through a reentrancy vulnerability in its Rebalancer contract, where the _burn function made external token transfers before updating reserve state, allowing repeated withdrawal against unmodified reserves. The Rebalancer contract's _burn function executed token transfers before updating pool reserves, violating the checks-effects-interactions pattern. This allowed a reentrant call to withdraw repeatedly against stale reserve values, draining more tokens than entitled. No reentrancy guard or proper state update order was present.
